info.name: Food Delivery System (Kubernetes)
info.description: Resource IDs are sent in the request body, not the URL. Run folders 01 to 09 in order; tokens and IDs are saved automatically.

item.name: View own profile (id from token, no body)
Change password (same password so later logins still work)
List menu of restaurant (id in body)
View another user's profile as admin (id in body)
Remove item 2 from cart (id in body)
Owner skips status PLACED to READY (rejected)
Instance info (answered by one of the 2 Customer pods)
